name: Spacewing War 2
storyline:
The mysterious space cult Shine Tomorrow has taken over the Milkdromeda Galaxy, and you must wreck their plans!
Fly into action in this new side-scrolling shoot’em-up. Along the way, find tons of secrets, shake up your weapons with powerful modifiers and face enemies and obstacles from every corner of this galaxy of wonders.

Spacewing, longtime defender of Earth, is now joined by Jimble, an extraterrestrial bounty hunter who can be controlled by a second player at any time. Even if you play alone, he will still pop up all over the adventure. Together, they travel the Solar Systems, meeting friends and foes alike! Can they gather enough power to reach the Heart of the Galaxy and uncover this conspiracy once and for all?

Presented in a stylish 16-bit style, this gripping sci-fi adventure of friendship and self-realization features accessible yet intense mechanics in the form of quick weapon swapping, diverse boss battles, strange transformations that change the gameplay and a whole lot of secret collectables.
summary: Fly into this new battle in this new side-scrolling shoot’em-up, face enemies and obstacles from every corner of the Milkdromeda Galaxy and encounter strange fun transformations that change the way the game plays.
